observed_behavior: Excel distance-matrix uploads were parsed through formatted display strings, so TN93 links slightly above 0.015 were rounded down to 0.015 and remained visible. The AngularTesting matrix path launched with 19 visible links instead of 17 and broke downstream grouped-threshold and nearest-neighbor journeys.
intended_behavior: Excel distance-matrix uploads should preserve the workbook's raw numeric precision so thresholding and downstream filtering match the equivalent edgelist behavior.
cause_summary: The XLS/XLSX matrix loader used `sheet_to_json(..., raw: false)`, which coerced workbook cells to formatted display strings and truncated TN93 values to three decimals before `parseFloat()` ran.
fix_summary: The matrix loader now reads XLS/XLSX sheets with `raw: true`, preserving full numeric precision and restoring the expected 17-link TN93 threshold behavior for the AngularTesting matrix fixture.
notes: Use `MTBG###` ids for new app-wide bug rows. Existing per-view bug-log CSVs remain historical references only.

observed_behavior: Applying a style or recalled settings could update the stored node-shape configuration without refreshing the already-rendered 2D nodes, so visible nodes kept their prior shapes until a later rerender.
intended_behavior: When style/session settings change node shapes, the rendered 2D nodes should immediately refresh to the configured symbol assignments.
cause_summary: After the 2D custom-shape refactor, `loadSettings()` normalized `node-symbol` but no longer called `updateNodeShapes()`, so existing Cytoscape nodes never received refreshed `shapeKey` and custom icon data during style/session load.
fix_summary: `loadSettings()` now calls `updateNodeShapes()` after normalizing `node-symbol`, which reapplies the current shape mapping to existing Cytoscape nodes during style/session load.
notes: A stale Cypress fixture (`Place` vs `Facility`) and stale `node.style('shape')` assertions were fixed in tests separately; map-view failures in this thread were assertion drift, not app bugs.

observed_behavior: After selecting rows-per-page `All`, filtering the table collapsed the component's tracked row count down to the current filtered size. When the user then switched datasets, the Table view no longer remembered that `All` was active and Links stayed truncated instead of expanding to the full visible dataset.
intended_behavior: If the user selects rows-per-page `All`, that mode should persist across filter changes and dataset switches so each dataset expands to its full visible row set.
cause_summary: The Table component inferred `All` mode from the paginator label text and overwrote `selectedRows` with the filtered row count. Once filtering changed the count, the paginator state was effectively reduced to a plain number and dataset switches lost the original `All` intent.
fix_summary: The Table component now tracks `All` mode explicitly, syncs paginator changes through `onPage`, and reapplies the current dataset length when `All` should remain active across filters, reloads, and dataset switches.
notes: The failing table-refresh journey also had a stale assertion that compared against total raw links instead of visible links and counted rendered `<tr>` nodes instead of the table model; those spec assertions were updated separately.

observed_behavior: A small Newick-backed 2D launch could render the graph but leave the Processing Files modal open indefinitely, and a stale asynchronous 2D render could throw `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'nativeElement')` after its component was destroyed.
intended_behavior: 2D launch should mark the network rendered and close the processing modal for small graphs, and stale asynchronous render work should exit without touching a destroyed Cytoscape container.
cause_summary: The initial 2D render awaited D3 precomputation and then unconditionally dereferenced `cyContainer`; if the component was torn down before the promise resolved, the container had already been cleared. The rendered-state transition also depended only on Cytoscape `layoutstop`, which did not reliably fire for the tiny preset-layout graph used by the SNP Newick fixture.
fix_summary: The 2D component now tracks destroy state, bails out after async precompute when the container is gone, and uses an idempotent layout-finish fallback so `networkRendered` is set even when the preset layout does not emit `layoutstop`.
notes: Discovered unexpectedly while adding patristic worker SNP metric coverage; the patristic distance calculation itself was correct.
